lead.headline: The 2-6 team is 5.07 points from the 6-2 team
lead.dek: Big Stric Energy opened the week a 10.97-point underdog to Bad things man bad things. Thursday’s 11.0 and two days of quiet cut that in half. Now it might come down to Monday night.
body: I’ve covered Big Stric Energy for nine weeks, and this is the first Saturday it has walked into as something close to a coin flip against a contender. Tuesday’s line had Bad things man bad things at 163.88 to 152.91, a 10.97-point spread and 60.4% to win. This morning it’s 163.95 to 158.88. The gap is 5.07, and Bad things is down to 54.9%.

The move came from two places. First, Thursday: the Jacksonville defense put 11.0 in the bank for Big Stric while Bad things had nobody playing. Second, nothing has happened since, and on a week like this that’s good news. Rashee Rice’s tag is gone. The Big Stric starting 11 is clean. Bad things has already settled every call. It’s 163.95 as set and 163.95 at its best, which means there’s no hidden upside left to unlock. What you see is what Big Stric has to beat.

Here’s the schedule wrinkle that makes this the week’s best game. Bad things gets its biggest number first. Bijan Robinson, projected 23.64, plays in the Sun 6:30 AM early game, along with kicker Evan McPherson. Big Stric’s Green Bay trio of Jordan Love, Josh Jacobs and Tucker Kraft is 42.29 projected and doesn’t start until Sun 1:25 PM. And Big Stric holds the Monday hammer: Josh Allen at 21.97 and Justin Jefferson at 17.76, both in the Monday game, 39.73 points that Bad things will have to sit and watch. Bad things’ only Monday answer is James Cook III at 14.84.

So the script writes itself. Bad things will likely be ahead most of Sunday. The question is whether the lead is big enough when Allen and Jefferson take the field. If Big Stric is within 25 going into Monday, I like its chances better than the 45.1% says.

One thing left on the Big Stric board, and it’s small: Jalen Coker at 13.83 is a tick better than Saquon Barkley at 12.8 in the flex, and Coker carries no tag. That’s 1.03 points in a 5.07-point game. I’d make it before Sun 10:00 AM, when both play.

What it means: Big Stric is 2-6 with 29.1% playoff odds and a W1 streak. Win this and that 29.1% starts to look like a real pulse. Bad things is 6-2 and in, at 100%, but it’s also chasing AB81 at 7-1 for first. Nobody in this game gets to coast.

quick_hits.headline: Garrett Wilson is Out. The Finest has two seats to fill.
quick_hits.body: Yesterday the Finest ate a locked 0.0 at quarterback. Today Garrett Wilson went from Questionable to Out with a concussion, and he’s still in the lineup at 0.0. This one has an answer: Denzel Boston is 10.72 on the bench, and Omar Cooper Jr. is 14.18 on the wire. The clock is Sun 10:00 AM, and the odds are down from 16.6% to 12.3%.

quick_hits.headline: deeboliciouskins has 41.48 points waiting on it
quick_hits.body: As set, deeboliciouskins projects 123.35. Make the calls and it’s 164.83: Patrick Mahomes at 21.24 for Kyler Murray’s 0.0, Rachaad White at 11.15 for Tony Pollard on bye, Malik Nabers at 15.82 now that his tag is gone, and the Kansas City defense at 8.73 over Minnesota’s 6.29. That’s the difference between an 87.7% favorite and a sweat.

quick_hits.headline: First place is the underdog this week
quick_hits.body: AB81 is 7-1, leads Cherry Blossom 22.58 to 15.58, and still only wins 36.6% of the time. That’s up from 30.9% on Tuesday, but its bench is now an injury ward: Mike Evans, DeVonta Smith and Sam Darnold are all Out, and Jalen Hurts is on IR. This is also the league’s luckiest team, at plus 3.0 wins. Cherry Blossom, on a W4 streak, is the pick, 165.2 to 151.97.

quick_hits.headline: McCaffrey, Fannin and Watson all lost their tags
quick_hits.body: Three of yesterday’s game-time decisions solved themselves. Christian McCaffrey is clean at 22.93 for Cherry Blossom, and Maye I touch your TDs? got Harold Fannin Jr. and Christian Watson back without a tag. That leaves Amon-Ra St. Brown and his ribs as the champ’s only open call.

quick_hits.headline: Poochinski’s Olave call is still sitting there
quick_hits.body: Chris Olave at 15.44 over Chris Godwin Jr. at 9.35 is worth 6.09, and it turns 171.84 into 177.93. Poochinski is 67.1% either way, down from 69% yesterday. Free points are free points. Take them before Sun 10:00 AM.

quick_hits.headline: Sunday starts at 6:30 AM this week
quick_hits.body: The early game locks Bijan Robinson, Ja’Marr Chase, Joe Burrow, Chase Brown, Tee Higgins and Drake London before most of this league has coffee. None of today’s open calls sit in that window, but anybody planning a last-minute swap involving those guys has until Sun 6:30 AM, not Sun 10:00 AM.

w9-m1.headline: Bad things gets Sunday. Big Stric gets Monday.
w9-m1.blurb: 163.95 to 158.88, and Bad things has nothing left to tune. Big Stric holds 39.73 projected in the Monday game. I’m picking Bad things, narrowly, and I’ll be watching Monday.

w9-m2.headline: deeboliciouskins needs four calls, not one
w9-m2.blurb: 164.83 to 117.78 on the live projection, and 87.7%. The Finest is playing with a locked 0.0 at quarterback and needs a Burrow game plus a lot of help.

w9-m3.headline: St. Brown’s ribs are the whole upset case
w9-m3.blurb: Poochinski is 177.93 to 159.83 with Olave in. Maye I touch your TDs? needs St. Brown’s 20.19 and big days from Purdy and Maye to close it. Poochinski, 67.1%.

w9-m4.headline: AB81 leads by 7. Cherry Blossom is still the pick.
w9-m4.blurb: Cherry Blossom projects 165.2 to 151.97 and has a clean lineup. AB81’s path is the Kittle shuffle and a big day from Jaxon Smith-Njigba at 24.05.

w9-r7-s4.headline: What will the Finest do at WR?
w9-r7-s4.blurb: Garrett Wilson is Out. Boston at 10.72 is the safe move off the bench. The better one is Omar Cooper Jr., 14.18 on the wire, and Cam Skattebo is Doubtful at 0.0 if the Finest needs a spot. Sun 10:00 AM.

w9-r7-s6.headline: Loveland’s real clock is still Sun 1:25 PM
w9-r7-s6.blurb: Colston Loveland at 10.84 over Hunter Henry at 7.66, Questionable with a foot, is 3.18. The listed Sun 5:20 PM is Loveland’s kickoff. Henry’s game comes first.

w9-r6-s0.headline: What will deeboliciouskins do at QB?
w9-r6-s0.blurb: Mahomes, 21.24, by Sun 10:00 AM. Murray is 0.0 and plays Monday, so waiting buys nothing. This call alone is worth more than half of the 41.48 on the board.

w9-r6-s4.headline: Nabers is clean. Pickens isn’t.
w9-r6-s4.blurb: Malik Nabers lost his tag and projects 15.82. George Pickens is Questionable at 13.54. That makes Nabers the starter at receiver, with Pickens fighting for a flex spot.

w9-r6-s8.headline: Pollard’s bye has a simple answer
w9-r6-s8.blurb: Rachaad White at 11.15, healthy, Sun 10:00 AM. DJ Moore at 12.78 is the higher number, but he’s Questionable and plays Monday. White’s the call unless this front office wants to sweat a Monday tag.

w9-r8-s5.headline: AB81’s Kittle shuffle is worth 7.89
w9-r8-s5.blurb: Kittle at tight end, Goedert to flex, Cooper to receiver, Lemon out: 15.87 over 7.98, and AB81 goes from 139.96 to 147.85. Lemon, Goedert and Cooper play Sun 10:00 AM, so that’s the real deadline, not Kittle’s Sun 1:05 PM.

w9-r3-s4.headline: St. Brown is the 9.13-point question
w9-r3-s4.blurb: He’s 20.19 and Questionable with ribs. Jaylen Waddle is 11.06 and clean. Same Sun 10:00 AM window, so check the inactives and start him if he’s active.

w9-r2-s4.headline: Olave over Godwin, still
w9-r2-s4.blurb: 15.44 to 9.35. Nothing has changed except the number of days it’s been on the board.

alert_notes.7: Lamar Jackson’s 0.0 at quarterback is locked for Week 9. Garrett Wilson is now Out too, but that slot can still be fixed before Sun 10:00 AM.

trending_notes.11625: 10.28. A bench body, nothing more for anyone here.
trending_notes.13150: AB81 is already starting him in the flex at 8.74. The wire has a better Cooper: Omar Cooper Jr. at 14.18.
trending_notes.8161: Bad things’ Wednesday add starts at quarterback this week, 17.61 over C.J. Stroud’s 16.85 on its bench.
trending_notes.3161: 112,002 adds and 14.48 projected. deeboliciouskins has Mahomes, so it doesn’t need him.
trending_notes.5849: Still Questionable and still 0.0. deeboliciouskins has the obvious fix on its bench.
trending_notes.3271: Poochinski’s bench tight end at 8.34 and 52,398 drops. Not a starter here.
